sepsis.key_pattern: Hemodynamic compromise + renal dysfunction: low SBP/MAP, elevated creatinine/BUN

composer_sepsis.key_pattern: High temporal risk escalation: elevated mean_score, rising score_trend, more alerts

pre_clinical_fp.definition: False positives that exhibit disease-associated feature patterns and may represent early/subclinical disease states.
characteristics: FPs form a coherent subgroup distinct from TNs (not random noise)
FPs show elevated disease-pathway-specific markers compared to TNs
FPs show suppressed protective or homeostatic markers
FPs have systematically high model confidence (near TP levels)

noise_fp.definition: False positives caused by measurement noise, data artifacts, or non-disease-related confounders.
characteristics: Random feature deviations without coherent biological pattern
Model confidence closer to TNs than TPs
No temporal progression in longitudinal data

classifier_assessment.reason: Domains have fundamentally different feature spaces (protein biomarkers vs clinical vitals/labs). A domain-agnostic FP classifier would require abstract feature representations (e.g., 'degree of organ dysfunction' rather than specific lab values).

shared_abstract_features.crc_proxy: tissue remodeling markers (SEPT9, S100A4, TIMP1, MMP9)
shared_abstract_features.sepsis_proxy: renal dysfunction (creatinine, BUN) + hemodynamic compromise (sbp, map)

shared_abstract_features.crc_proxy: prediction score relative to TP distribution

classifier_assessment.recommendation: Instead of a universal classifier, develop domain-specific pre-clinical FP scores using the identified signatures, then meta-analyze at the abstract feature level.

key_findings: Both CRC and sepsis FPs form coherent subgroups (not random noise) — multi-feature permutation p<0.001 for CRC, multiple |d|>1.0 features for sepsis
Both domains show elevated disease-pathway markers in FPs: tissue remodeling (CRC) and organ dysfunction (sepsis)
Both domains show suppressed protective markers: inflammatory cytokines (CRC), hemodynamic stability (sepsis)
COMPOSER temporal data shows FPs have model confidence near TP levels (d=+2.28 for mean_score), suggesting the model detects a real signal
A universal cross-domain FP classifier is not feasible with raw features due to incompatible feature spaces — abstract feature representations needed
The shared meta-pattern of 'disease-specific marker elevation + protective marker suppression' may represent a general pre-clinical signature motif
